name: spellkave_define_consequence
label: Define Consequence (verb)
description: Author ONE consequence_templates row (+ its consequence_frame_writes satellites, in authored order) in a single call, with NO actor grant (contrast spellkave_define_behavior, which always binds its generated consequence to a `grant_to` caster's action cluster). Self-scaffolds the [[bundles]] header if `bundle` has none yet. #1968 workspace idempotency: re-authoring the SAME bundle+id REPLACES the row + every consequence_frame_writes row wholesale (fewer frame_writes on a re-run means the stale ones are gone, not left behind).

bundle.description: bundle_id stamped on the consequence_templates row. Omit to fall back to `context.defaultBundle` (#1968 smart default).

id.description: Local consequence_template_id stem; the full id is '<bundle>/<id>' (e.g. bundle='core', id='pickup/success' -> 'core/pickup/success').

effect_ref.description: consequence_templates.effect_refs_csv — an already-authored effect_definitions id this consequence invokes (e.g. a scheduled-zone/summon effect). The corpus never joins more than one id here despite the column's '_csv' name — a single ref, not a real CSV list. Omit for a consequence with no effect_definitions reference.

frame_writes.description: consequence_frame_writes rows, in AUTHORED order — each a raw FrameWriteOp body object or the unit string BreakPlaceSeal (e.g. {Inscribe: {...}}, {ModifyResource: {...}}, {PickupTargetItem: {...}}), mirroring spellkave_write_rows' own untyped row shape (the closed Rust FrameWriteOp enum is never modeled in TypeBox here). `ordinal` (0-based) is derived from array position — never hand-specified.
